server_runtime.fa3_dependency_preparation: npm ci --omit=dev under the immutable root lock; normal launch performs no npm mutation

desktop_wrapper.observed_lifecycle: Electron app waits for SillyTavern SERVER_STARTED event, receives the actual server URL and loads it into BrowserWindow; window close quits the desktop process on non-macOS.

runtime_install_observation: The upstream src/electron/start.sh performs npm install before normal launch. FA3 does not adopt that runtime mutation semantics. The root SillyTavern server dependency set and the Electron wrapper dependency set are prepared in a separate explicit admission step under their respective immutable lockfiles; ordinary desktop launch is dependency-install-free.
security_observation: The root .npmrc at the admitted commit sets ignore-scripts=true and min-release-age=7. The 1.18.0 release notes also reference a security incident involving the third-party Bot Browser extension; FA3 treats third-party extensions as separately admitted supply-chain/runtime components.
